[[File:Zeus.png|thumb|250px|Zeus]] '''Zeus''' (Japanese: '''ゼウス''' ''Zeus'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG183|Aipom and Circumstance!]]''. Zeus was the king of a village in [[Kanto]]. Per the traditions of the village, a competition was held to find a new king. The person who possessed the crown by sundown will be crowned the new king. At the end of the day, [[Hank]] was holding the crown and thus named as the king. Zeus was not seen much throughout the course of the episode and so little was known about him. However, he seemed quite eccentric for thinking it would be acceptable to have an {{p|Aipom}} for a king. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{unknown color}}|bordercolor={{unknown color light}} |ja=藤本譲 ''Yuzuru Fujimoto'' |en=[[Carter Cathcart|Billy Beach]] |it=Mario Zucca |fi=Pasi Ruohonen |fr_eu=Daniel Nicodème |es_eu=Luis Vicente Ivars}} ==Trivia== * Zeus's name refers to the {{wp|Zeus|king of the gods}} in {{wp|Greek mythology}}.
